parallel_execution.strategy: Pilot resource use, then schedule small batches of independent teachers; do not launch ten full-size4096-env processes

teacher_learning.method: PPO with phase-conditioned reference imitation rewards and task/physical costs
teacher_learning.reset: Random reference phase, with physically valid initial support and velocities
teacher_learning.observations: Can include privileged simulator state/reference for the specialist; log deployable student observations alongside
teacher_learning.actions: 15 complete independent motor targets with existing PD/torque-speed limits; q_ref is not a teacher action label
teacher_learning.curriculum: Own action family from the beginning. Scale difficulty within that family, not toward a common forward command.
teacher_learning.acceptance: Per-teacher independent seeds, sustained cycles, direction/yaw response, all-foot contact events, slip and actuator metrics; survival alone is insufficient

student_distillation.sample_teacher_families: balanced, with explicit gait phase/duty/frequency and task command conditions
student_distillation.supervision: Complete executed target/teacher distribution from physically validated teacher rollouts, not animation joint positions
stages: DAgger with the matching specialist on student-visited states inside its valid domain
Independent student evaluation for each family
On-policy PPO for skill transitions and robustness
student_distillation.gait_disambiguation: Existing relative-leg phases distinguish walk/trot/pace; if skills remain indistinguishable at identical commands, version schema and add a skill condition rather than mixing contradictory labels
student_distillation.transitions: Train transitions after individual skills pass; use support-aware phase transitions, braking and zero-velocity crossings
